calc.spot_why: Spot is the CRYPTO NOVA AI portfolio, with no leverage. The core — Bitcoin 30%, Ether 10%, Solana 5% — is held for the long run; coins the table marks «can buy» get 7.5% each with a −20% stop; risky ones 2.5% each; at least 10% stays in dollars. At most 8 coins including the core. Another 10% of the account is extra core: BTC, ETH and SOL in the same 30 / 10 / 5 proportions.
calc.cash_why: The system always keeps at least 10% of the portfolio in dollars: that is what it uses to top up the core in dips.
calc.active_why: Active spot is «BTC momentum»: when Bitcoin rises 2.5% or more in an hour, the system buys the most liquid altcoins on spot — they usually catch up. No leverage, up to 5 positions, exit after 12 hours. Between trades this part waits in BTC; after an exit it stays in dollars for up to 3 days, until a new signal.
calc.futures_why: Futures are run by the CRYPTO NOVA AI system. Leverage is set for each signal, a trade risks at most 2% of the budget, the stop is on the exchange. Losses happen too: the stop or a reversed signal closes a losing trade. CRYPTO NOVA AI's real account since 21 Nov 2026: 7 futures trades closed, 1 of them in profit.

moved.label: Reallocation between spot and futures
moved.why_ru: This is not a money transfer, a fee, or a profit or loss. Spot and futures run on one OKX account with the same USDT. The system splits the account's current value, not its starting value: spot 75%, futures 15%, active spot 0%. So futures now get $465.49 less than their starting share plus their own result, and spot gets the same amount more. Of this difference, +$128.11 is the futures' share of the change in the whole account's value, and −$593.60 is how the shares drifted between recalculations: coin prices move all the time, and the system rebalances only when the gap passes a threshold.
